purpose: A mid-course control-plane review before further structural work: compare completed requirements, inserted requirements, open/deferred tasks, runtime artifacts, long-term memory boundaries, and provider policy.

summary.human_readable: RedCap 当前不是缺少一个可直接自动推进的发布主线任务，而是需要先把新暴露的治理缺口纳入机器检查：关键脚本头部说明、LLM-wiki-lite 边界表达、任务树中途对账。
summary.release_state: P4-2 formal public release remains blocked-external; P4-2h public distillation remains deferred.
summary.next_engineering_posture: Continue with small, evidence-backed governance fixes before any broad physical directory surgery or public release.

dimensions.decision: Keep completed child tasks as completed only where parent ledger cites durable evidence or receipts.
Treat the script-header, LLM-wiki visibility, and midcourse-review concerns as a new P2-7 child instead of silently appending them to a closed P2-6 task.
Keep P4-2h deferred and P4-2 blocked-external; do not convert them into automatic work without release/public-export authorization.
Critical script-like dictionary entries must have a short Chinese purpose marker and a Dictionary backlink near the file head.

LLM-wiki-lite remains a private, non-authoritative, source-anchored semantic memory layer; full LLM-wiki, background generation, RAG/GraphRAG, vector store, and public writeback remain future/deferred capabilities.
Do not perform broad physical deletion/migration as part of this review; existing information architecture and legacy asset checks remain the safety boundary.
Use Claude Code and Kimi where available; keep Copilot as protected fallback only when Claude Code and Kimi are both unavailable.

deferred_items.reason: Historical asset public distillation needs RedCap Forge safety review and append-only public export boundaries; not required for immediate CLI release engineering.
Formal public release remains blocked by external release decisions: registry, credentials, license posture, and explicit publish authorization.
Full LLM-wiki, background generator, vector/RAG/GraphRAG and public writeback are future architecture work, not part of the current LLM-wiki-lite lifecycle.

must_not_claim: Do not claim this review makes RedCap public-release-ready.
Do not claim LLM-wiki-lite is a complete LLM-wiki product.
Do not claim historical private assets have been publicly distilled into redcap-arsenal.
Do not claim broad directory surgery is safe without its own apply task and rollback evidence.
Do not call Copilot from RedCap automatic paths while Claude Code or Kimi is available.
